502:t_1:3.en: ～$$プトレマイオス２改$$　Briefing Room～

502:t_1:4.en:
$$クィーン$$
「...It seems everyone has gathered.」

502:t_1:5.en:
$$ブライト$$
「As usual, you communicate entirely on your own terms.」

502:t_1:6.en:
$$クィーン$$
「I receive reports on your every movement, so there's no need for you to report to me.」

502:t_1:7.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「It seems the third $$クロノ$$ has considerable organizational strength, too.」

502:t_1:8.en:
$$クィーン$$
「Still, we have no combat forces to deploy, so we have to rely on you.」

502:t_1:9.en:
$$オットー$$
「Then what sort of information will you provide today?」

502:t_1:10.en:
$$クィーン$$
「About $$サイド１$$, where you're headed next...」

502:t_1:11.en:
$$クィーン$$
「$$リリーナ・ドーリアン$$, who has fallen into the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives' hands, is there.」

502:t_1:13.en:
$$オットー$$
「Wasn't she supposed to be a prisoner of $$サイデリアル$$...!?」

502:t_1:14.en:
$$クィーン$$
「The $$クロノ$$ Conservatives probably took custody of her to use in their operation.」

502:t_1:15.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Her being at $$サイド１$$ is probably no coincidence.」

502:t_1:16.en:
$$クィーン$$
「The $$クロノ$$ Conservatives learned of your movements and seem to have prepared her as a means of intercepting you.」

502:t_1:17.en:
$$クィーン$$
「I suppose they're eliminating obstacles to demonstrate their loyalty to $$サイデリアル$$.」

502:t_1:18.en:
$$オットー$$
「So they're using Vice Foreign Minister $$ドーリアン#relena$$ to set some sort of trap...!?」

502:t_1:19.en:
$$クィーン$$
「That's all the information I have. Now...I'll see how you handle it.」

502:t_1:20.en:
$$オットー$$
「Honestly...! That woman is as selfish as ever!」

502:t_1:21.en:
$$ブライト$$
「But her information is useful again. If we'd headed straight for $$サイド１$$ unaware, we'd simply have fallen into their trap.」

502:t_1:22.en:
$$オットー$$
「But what do we do? Without knowing $$クロノ$$'s movements, we can't send an infiltration team...」

502:t_1:23.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「In that case, why don't we deliberately fall into the enemy's trap?」

502:t_1:25.en:
$$オットー$$
「If we do something that idiotic...」

502:t_1:27.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「If we're going to do it, let's send in an exceptional idiot who'll leave them stunned.」

502:t_1:33.en:
$$グエン$$
「Please stop sulking, Vice Foreign Minister $$ドーリアン#relena$$.」

502:t_1:34.en:
$$グエン$$
「No... With the $$地球連邦$$ government already all but collapsed, it would be inappropriate to address you by your office.」

502:t_1:35.en:
$$グエン$$
「Allow me to call you Queen $$リリーナ$$.」

502:t_1:37.en:
$$グエン$$
「My name is $$グエン・サード・ラインフォード$$. I come from $$ＵＣＷ$$ and currently serve as an agent of $$クロノ$$.」

502:t_1:38.en:
$$グエン$$
「There is no point asking me about $$クロノ$$'s organization, incidentally. I am a newcomer, after all.」

502:t_1:39.en:
$$グエン$$
「That is why I am assigned duties that require me to do the legwork.」

502:t_1:40.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Your name suggests you come from a long-established family. Are you unaware that your actions are disgraceful?」

502:t_1:41.en:
$$グエン$$
「Of course I am aware. Using hostages is the lowest of tactics.」

502:t_1:42.en:
$$グエン$$
「I believe being able to do so despite that awareness is another of my talents.」

502:t_1:44.en:
$$メリーベル$$
「Watch your tongue, former queen. You're just bait now, rather than some big shot in the government.」

502:t_1:45.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「I am $$リリーナ・ドーリアン$$.」

502:t_1:46.en:
$$メリーベル$$
「Those eyes...! Figures! I can't stand anyone who calls herself a queen!」

502:t_1:47.en:
$$グエン$$
「Stop that, $$メリーベル$$. We may indeed be the lowest of people, but we should still observe basic courtesy.」

502:t_1:49.en:
$$グエン$$
「My companion was rude, Queen $$リリーナ$$.」

502:t_1:50.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「The 《$$サンクキングダム$$》 is gone, and I am no longer Vice Foreign Minister. Do you think I have value as a hostage?」

502:t_1:51.en:
$$グエン$$
「You are too modest. I know your name carries great influence on both Earth and the colonies.」

502:t_1:52.en:
$$グエン$$
「Above all, the members of $c would hardly sit idle if they knew you were here.」

502:t_1:54.en:
$$グエン$$
「We learned of their movements and hurriedly brought you here.」

502:t_1:55.en:
$$グエン$$
「However, from here on, the operational force will take over from us agents.」

502:t_1:56.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Will you use me as a hostage to demand their surrender?」

502:t_1:57.en:
$$グエン$$
「I am not privy to the operation. ...A member of the operational force should arrive shortly. Please ask him for the details.」

502:t_1:58.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Wait. You called yourself a newcomer earlier. Why did you join $$クロノ$$?」

502:t_1:59.en:
$$グエン$$
「Forgive the rudeness of answering a question with another question, but what do you intend to do once you hear my answer?」

502:t_1:60.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Whatever your reason, I will do everything I can to persuade you to reconsider.」

502:t_1:61.en:
$$メリーベル$$
「This woman still doesn't seem to understand her position!」

502:t_1:62.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Even if I fall, they...$c will do that in my stead.」

502:t_1:63.en:
$$グエン$$
「I see... I understand how you feel.」

502:t_1:64.en:
$$グエン$$
「I know some of them myself, after all.」

502:t_1:66.en:
$$グエン$$
「Our time is up, Queen $$リリーナ$$. I wish you good luck.」

502:t_1:67.en:
$$グエン$$
「If you happen to meet $$ロラン・セアック$$ of $c, please tell him $$グエン$$ sends his regards.」

502:t_1:68.en:
$$メリーベル$$
「Bye-bye, Your Majesty. Be sure to do a good job as bait.」

502:t_1:72.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$! Have you come to rescue me!?」

502:t_1:73.en:
$$リディ$$
「...Please don't misunderstand. I am here to make use of you.」

502:t_1:75.en:
$$リディ$$
「I am no longer with $c. I command $$クロノ$$'s operational force.」

502:t_2:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「...So a force of that size couldn't stop $$ヒイロ$$ and the others.」

502:t_2:4.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Wait, Ensign $$リディ$$! Are you going to fight!?」

502:t_2:6.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Are you going to fight $c...your former comrades!?」

502:t_2:9.en:
$$リディ$$
「You are $$リリーナ・ピースクラフト$$...the last queen of the fallen $$サンクキングダム$$...」

502:t_2:11.en:
$$リディ$$
「Just as you inherited your late father's wishes, I will fulfill the $$マーセナス家$$'s duty...my role as a member of $$クロノ$$.」

502:t_2:12.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「The $$マーセナス家$$ is part of $$クロノ$$...」
